```{r}
library(knitr)

sigfig <- function(vec, n = 3) {
  ### function to round values to N significant digits
  # input:  vec     vector of numeric
  #         n       integer is the required sigfig  
  # output: outvec  vector of numeric rounded to N sigfig
  formatC(signif(vec, digits = n), digits = n, format = "fg", flag = "#") 
}

theme_set(theme_ggdist())
theme_update(
  text = element_text(size = 24),
  plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
  legend.position = "bottom"
)

set_cmdstan_path(path = Sys.getenv("CMDSTAN_PATH"))

knitr::knit_engines$set(
  stan = function(options) {
    code <- knitr:::one_string(options$code)
    out <- options$output.var
    if (!is.character(out) || length(out) != 1L) {
      stop(
        "the chunk option output.var must be a character string ",
        "providing a name for the returned `CmdStanModel` object."
      )
    }
    if (options$eval) {
      if (options$cache) {
        cache_path <- knitr:::valid_path(
          options[["cache.path"]],
          options$label
        )
        if (!dir.exists(cache_path)) {
          dir.create(cache_path)
        }
        model_file <- tempfile(
          fileext = ".stan",
          tmpdir = cache_path
        )
        cat(code, "\n", file = model_file)
      } else {
        model_file <- write_stan_file(code)
      }
      csm <- cmdstan_model(model_file)
      assign(out, csm, envir = knit_global())
    }
    knitr::engine_output(options, code, "")
  }
)
```



```{r}
#| include: false

df0 <- read_excel("D://workR/Blog/Projects/Locomotion/data/locomotion.xlsx", sheet = 1)

df <- df0 %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  mutate(distance_m = distance_m + 0.01,
         animal = as.factor(animal))

df %>% 
  filter(group == "VPA-METH") %>%
  ggplot(aes(minute, distance_m, color = group)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(group = animal), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = animal)) +
  scale_y_log10() 

df %>% 
  group_by(animal, litter) %>% 
  summarize(n = n()) %>% 
  arrange(-n)
```

#### Model options

##### y ~ 1 + time * group + (1 | animal) + Normal(0, sigma)

```{r}
#| include: false


brm1 <- brm(bf(distance_m ~ 1 + minute * group + (1 | animal)),
            family = gaussian(),
            data = df,
            backend = "cmdstanr",
            cores = 4,
            file = "brm1")

# summary(brm1)
# conditional_effects((brm1))
```


```{r}
df %>% 
  add_epred_draws(brm1, ndraws = 50, re_formula = NULL) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(minute, distance_m, color = group)) +
  geom_point(data = df) +
  # geom_line(data = df, aes(group = animal)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = .epred, group = paste(.draw, animal)), alpha = 0.1) +
  facet_grid(model ~ meth) +
  # scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "Timepoints (minute)",
       y = "Distance (m)",
       color = NULL)
```
